title: Beyond periodicity: Fourier methods for optimal control
summary: Fourier-based spectral methods provide compact global approximations, permit simple differentiation and integration, and achieve spectral convergence for smooth periodic functions. Their use in finite-horizon optimal control problems (OCPs) is nevertheless challenged by the generally nonperiodic state and control trajectories: endpoint mismatch induces artificial discontinuities and can destroy spectral convergence.
